name: DeepSeek V4 Model Architecture
description: Standalone extraction of the user-approved V4 Mapping Explorer whole-model graph.

source.visualContract: Shared Graphviz geometry and anchored expansion; L0 folds Attention/MoE internals while retaining both mHC residual paths. Flash report presentation uses neutral computation, green value/state grids, purple parameter grids and dashed parameter reads. Main and residual tensor flows use single connectors; Mix B is a vertical text annotation. Report layout packs sublayers with 48px clear main-node gaps and fits expanded containers to visible descendants. Tensor grids have 2px channels and 8px border insets; unselected compute pills have no border. Preview legend uses an info icon button.
source.parityNote: Original module imports shared renderer and CSS. Supporting registry files are frozen V4 source snapshots; compare hashes before updating either. Shared model-graphviz and DV4 sidecar remain dependencies.

forbiddenOverrides: Rebuilding SVG node/edge geometry in the preview
Changing model facts while extracting presentation
useWhen: previewing the approved V4 whole-model architecture alone
reusing Mapping Explorer graph behavior without its implementation/source panes
limitations: Source references are metadata; source files are not bundled in this preview.
Flash layer 2 is calibrated against the local model.py and inference-config.json; runtime values are not collected.
V4-specific fixture, not a generic schema adapter.

layoutRouting.expanded: Three branch columns; persistent states beside compute flow
layoutRouting.ports: Independent ports with aligned local paths preferred
layoutRouting.routing: Orthogonal obstacle avoidance; no shared segments
layoutRouting.validation: report-layout.test.cjs checks 63 expansion combinations for invalid routes, shared segments and node intersections
